body.p: This paper is in response to the Restriction Requirement mailed September 24, 2024 in which the Examiner has required restriction between the following patentably distinct species

Species A, At least Fig. 3 detailing a device for reacting thrust forces of a propulsion system according to a first embodiment where the rear engine attachment 208 is articulated to the main fitting 310; and the rear engine attachment 208 has a rear rod 402 with three points, of which one point 402a, included in the median vertical plane V, ensures mounting articulated to the main fitting 310, and of which two points 402b-c, which are symmetrical to one another with respect to the median vertical plane V, ensure mounting articulated to the engine 204 of the turbomachine 102. The axis of articulation of each point 402a-c is generally parallel to the longitudinal axis of the turbomachine 102.

Species B, At least Fig. 5 detailing a device for reacting thrust forces of a propulsion system according to a second embodiment where the rear engine attachment 208 is separate from the main fitting 310.
In response, Applicant elects Species A covering the embodiment of FIG. 3. This election is made without traverse.

Applicant has selected Species A, as indicated above. Applicant submits that all of the pending claims read on at least Species A and therefore, no claims have been withdrawn. Further, Applicant has added a new claim 6 which is fully supported and reads on the elected species.
Applicant reserves the right to timely file a divisional application based on any withdrawn claims or to seek rejoinder of same in the present application-if appropriate.
Applicant submits that all of the issues raised in the Restriction Requirement have been addressed. In the event the Examiner finds that there are additional issues which
may be resolved by telephone, the Examiner is urged to contact Applicant's undersigned attorney at the telephone number below.
